  FROM trips_daily
  WHERE service_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND service_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

sql:
SELECT
  borough,
  SUM(total_pickups) AS total_pickups,
  SUM(ontime_pickups) AS ontime_pickups,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(ontime_pickups) / SUM(total_pickups), 1) AS otp_pct
FROM pickup_otp_daily
WHERE service_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND service_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND standard = '15-minutes'
GROUP BY borough
ORDER BY otp_pct ASC;
notes: Assumed the 15-minute standard only, since each trip appears once per standard and that standard covers all of 2025; OTP is combined across Primary and Broker, and results are sorted lowest OTP first.

sql:
SELECT
  provider_type AS provider,
  standard,
  SUM(total_pickups) AS pickups_measured,
  SUM(ontime_pickups) AS ontime_pickups,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(ontime_pickups) / NULLIF(SUM(total_pickups), 0), 1) AS ontime_pct
FROM pickup_otp_daily
WHERE service_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND service_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND provider_type IN ('Primary', 'Broker')
GROUP BY provider_type, standard
ORDER BY standard, provider_type;
notes: Assumes calendar year 2025, on-time % = sum(ontime_pickups)/sum(total_pickups) per provider and OTP standard, reported separately by standard because each trip appears once per standard (so pooling standards would double count).

sql: SELECT strftime(service_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, standard, SUM(total_pickups) AS pickups, SUM(ontime_pickups) AS ontime_pickups, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(ontime_pickups) / NULLIF(SUM(total_pickups), 0), 1) AS otp_pct FROM pickup_otp_daily WHERE service_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND service_date < DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2;
notes: Assumes 2026 means Jan–Dec 2026 (data available through Sep 2026), OTP is ontime/total pickups aggregated across all boroughs and provider types, and results are split by OTP standard (15/20/30 min) because each trip is counted once per standard.

sql:
WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM service_date) AS yr,
    SUM(ontime_pickups) AS ontime,
    SUM(total_pickups) AS total
  FROM pickup_otp_daily
  WHERE standard = '30-minutes'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM service_date) BETWEEN 2017 AND 2025
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  yr AS calendar_year,
  ROUND(100.0 * ontime / total, 1) AS ontime_pct_30min
FROM yearly
ORDER BY ontime_pct_30min DESC
LIMIT 1;
notes: Assumes "full calendar year" means 2017–2025 (2016 starts in October and 2026 is incomplete), OTP is computed as total on-time pickups divided by total pickups across all boroughs and Primary/Broker providers for the 30-minute standard, and each trip is counted once under that standard.

sql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT SUM(complaints) AS complaints
  FROM complaints_daily
  WHERE opened_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND opened_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
),
t AS (
  SELECT SUM(trips) AS trips
  FROM trips_daily
  WHERE service_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND service_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
)
SELECT
  c.complaints AS complaints_2024,
  t.trips AS trips_2024,
  ROUND(1000.0 * c.complaints / t.trips, 1) AS complaints_per_1000_trips
FROM c, t;
notes: Assumes all complaint provider types and all trip provider types/boroughs are included in the calendar-year 2024 totals (complaints by opened_date, trips by service_date), so the rate is a system-wide approximation rather than a strictly matched provider-level rate.

notes: Assumes average ride time per trip is the trip-weighted mean across all provider types, peak periods, boroughs and max-ride-time flags in 2023 (total ride minutes divided by total completed trips), rounded to 1 decimal.

SELECT
  peak_hour,
  SUM(trips) AS completed_trips,
  SUM(ride_time_min) AS total_ride_minutes,
  ROUND(SUM(ride_time_min) * 1.0 / SUM(trips), 1) AS avg_ride_time_min
FROM ride_time_monthly
WHERE month >= DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND month < DATE '2023-01-01'
GROUP BY peak_hour

WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(year FROM service_date) AS cal_year,
         SUM(trips) AS total_trips,
         COUNT(DISTINCT service_date) AS days_with_data
  FROM trips_daily
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT cal_year AS year,
       total_trips AS trips,
       days_with_data AS days_with_data
FROM yearly
WHERE cal_year BETWEEN 2017 AND 2025
ORDER BY total_trips ASC
LIMIT 1;
notes: Assumes full calendar years are 2017–2025, since the data starts in Oct 2016 (2016 partial) and ends Sep 2026 (2026 partial), and that trips_daily summed across all provider types and boroughs is the intended trip count.
